title: Hyperparameter optimization methods for subject-independent human activity recognition: benchmark code and results (v2.0.4)
description: Code, Colab notebook and raw results (1,065 searches, 119,090 evaluations) for the benchmark of Grid Search, Random Search, TPE, CMA-ES, a genetic algorithm and BOHB for SVM, Random Forest and XGBoost on five human activity recognition datasets (UCI HAR, WISDM, PAMAP2, MotionSense, HARTH) with subject-independent evaluation. Includes the Bayesian signed-rank equivalence analysis.
